publication_time_rule: pubDate must include an explicit UTC offset and must not be later than archive_capture_at

record_contract.canonicalization: https://www.ecb.europa.eu + normalized path; drop query and fragment; map legacy ecb.int host
record_contract.deduplication: canonical link; retain first valid archive capture

rights_scope: Use only ECB RSS title metadata with ECB attribution; do not ingest linked full documents, media, logos, named-author papers, or third-party content.
stop_rule: Corpus gate may authorize only outcome-blind LLM extraction. Market targets, predictive metrics, thresholds and backtests remain prohibited.
